PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen Win Titles at Hylo Open 2026

Indian badminton players PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen have both secured victories at the Hylo Open 2026. PV Sindhu reached the final of the tournament, defeating Anmol Kharab in the semi-finals. Lakshya Sen also won a title at the event, contributing to a double victory for India.
